themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers research and development of autonomous AI agents designed to perform tasks and make decisions with minimal human intervention, especially in research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including research into their effectiveness and security implications.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses various AI-powered tools designed to aid in the research process, from data analysis and synthesis to literature review and experimental design.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, benchmark, or review different AI tools and platforms, focusing on their performance, cost, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.name: Generative AI design
themes.description: Explores the use of generative AI in the design process, including AI-assisted prototyping, asset creation, and the evolution of design tools.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI capabilities for summarizing large amounts of text, data, or conversations to extract key insights and information.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being applied to product development, including user research insights, feature prioritization, and product strategy.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user representations for testing, simulation, and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and employment trends across various industries.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the research and development of AI chatbots, including their applications, user interactions, and potential societal impacts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
